A.description: Airy sheet: a passing whoosh with slight flutter, a soft paper rustle landing on a plastic bin bottom.

B.description: Crisp and quick: a brighter, shorter whoosh, a crackly rustle and a faint ring of a steel mesh bin.

C.description: Soft flutter: a slower, darker whoosh of a flapping sheet, a muffled rustle and a deeper thump.

B1.description: B, lighter and shorter: a smooth bright whoosh, a brief crisp landing, the faintest steel ring.

B2.description: B, richer and denser: the sheet crinkles in flight, a fuller crackling landing with a soft puff and a light steel ring.

B3.description: B, drier and closer: almost no room, finer resonant paper ticks with more fibre sheen, no bin ring.

B4.description: B with a more defined bin contact: the landing ends on a clear tap of a steel bin rim.

A.description: A short soft rustle, then a light tap on a moulded plastic bin.

B.description: A short rustle, then a tiny tap on a thin steel bin that rings briefly.

C.description: A lighter rustle, then a hollow woody tock with the bin's air cavity.

B1.description: B, lighter and shorter: a brief fine rustle and a small steel tick.

B2.description: B, richer and denser: a fuller rustle with micro-crackles, a soft puff and a ringing steel tap.

B3.description: B, drier and closer: crisp resonant paper ticks, almost no room, a short steel tick.

B4.description: B with a more defined bin contact: a firmer tap with contact noise on the steel bin.

A.description: Crisp crumple, about 0.6 s: crackling bursts that darken as the ball compacts.

B.description: Tight and quick crumple, about 0.5 s, ending with the ball dropping softly into the bin.

C.description: Soft tissue-like crumple, about 0.75 s: smoother, darker, few crackles.

B1.description: B, lighter and shorter (~0.4 s): a quick fine crumple and a soft drop.

B2.description: B, richer and denser (~0.6 s): clustered crackles darkening as the ball compacts, then the drop.

B3.description: B, drier and closer: crisp resonant crackles with fibre sheen, almost no room, a light puff at the end.

B4.description: B with a more defined bin contact: the ball lands with an audible steel bin tap.

A.description: Two-note glass chime (D6 then G6, a fourth up) from small glass bowl modes.

B.description: Airy rising swish ending on a faint glass tink.

C.description: Two-note soft woody pop from tuned-bar modes (G5 then D6).

B1.description: B refined: a smoother, narrower swish into a glass-bowl tink on E7, tink a little more present (~0.36 s).

B2.description: B refined with a tuned chime: the swish ends on two near-harmonic glass tinks, A6 then E7 (~0.42 s).

B3.description: B refined, short: a quick soft swish and a clear glass-bowl tink on C7 in front (~0.3 s).

B4.description: B refined, pitched: the swish narrows onto the chime's pitch and lands on a tuned glass tink on D7 (~0.42 s).

A.description: Alert: two small glass bowls struck together, a fifth apart (E6, B6).
Alert: two quick knocks on a tuned wooden bar (A5), the second softer.
Alert: a bubble-like resonance whose pitch rises quickly, with a faint tick.
Alert: a pebble on a small steel dish, bright and short.
Volume keys: one soft, short tap on a tuned bar (E6).
Shutter double click, 60 ms apart: filtered transients, a tiny steel blade body, light housing.

B.description: Leaf shutter: a tighter, brighter double click 35 ms apart, little body.

C.description: Reflex-camera style: a heavier first click with a bounce and a spring ring, then the return 90 ms later.

B1.description: B with real mechanics: two blade snaps 35 ms apart, a mid mechanism body, a subtle spring, faint blade travel.

B2.description: B, warmer: 45 ms apart, a lower body tone and a slightly longer spring.

B3.description: B, tight and small: 30 ms apart, a bright compact mechanism.

B4.description: B, slower and more mechanical: 55 ms apart, audible blade travel and a defined spring ring.
